Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Alert: elevated 5xx rate detected on /v1/* and control-plane API (auth/org-lookup/config). PagerDuty PD-6789 triggered. first_seen=2026-03-10T13:42:01Z (ts=1781204321)
Sam Li (oncall): Ack, I'm on it. Looking at the top-level SLO dashboard now, seeing sharp 5xx spike correlated with control-plane latencies.
Priya Desai (eng-sre): I can see increased timeouts on org-lookup (p50 jumped to 600ms, p95 to 2.8s). Traces show repeated retries to billing-config service.
Jun Park (runtime): We rolled config v12 ~6m ago that changed org lookup cache TTL + new feature flag for per-tenant config fetches. Could be a regression.
Deploy Bot: deploy: release/controlplane@2026.03.10-cfg deployed to canary at 2026-03-10T13:36:40Z
Mateo Cruz (platform): Autoscaler didn't scale quickly — control-plane pods at 94% CPU, queue depth high. Manually scaling now (replicas 6 -> 12).
Sam Li (oncall): Mitigation plan (short): 1) rollback config v12 -> v11 2) enable fail-open cache for org-lookup 3) route non-critical traffic to cached responses / degraded mode 4) whiteboard customers with higher SLAs for manual reroute.
Priya Desai (eng-sre): Starting rollback to v11 on canary, will promote if green. Command: ```kubectl -n redwood-controlplane rollout undo deployment/control-plane --to-revision=11```
Priya Desai (eng-sre): Also flipping feature flag to fail-open: ```redis-cli -h config-ff set org_lookup_fail_open true``` — doing now.
Billing Service: ERROR 13:42:07 downstream timeout to billing-config-service id=9f7c3a status=504 ttl=0.002s 
Jun Park (runtime): Sample trace (traced spans collapsed): 
```
root: api-gateway -> control-plane/auth (35ms) -> org-lookup (1200ms retry) -> billing-config (timeout 500ms) -> return 502
```
Priya Desai (eng-sre): After enabling fail-open + rollback start, p50 org-lookup dropped to ~120ms within two minutes. 5xx rate trending down from 14% -> 6%.
Sam Li (oncall): Customer impact summary for comms: ~15% of requests across hosted API saw 5xx/504 between 13:42-13:50 UTC. Affected features: chat generation endpoints and route-config lookups (control-plane). No data exfiltration, no billing drift.
Mateo Cruz (platform): I pushed a temporary routing rule to divert non-critical tenant traffic to cached config: ```POST /internal/routing/add-rule { "match": "tenant.tier != enterprise", "action": "use-cached-config" }```
Priya Desai (eng-sre): Confirming manual scale completed, replicas=12, pods passing readiness.
Incident Bot: Incident page: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/1781204321 created (severity=SEV2). PagerDuty: PD-6789 assigned to Sam Li.
Sam Li (oncall): Handoff note: I'm going to stabilize for next 15m and then handoff to Priya for postmortem and customer comms. Priya, you good to take after 13:55 UTC?
Priya Desai (eng-sre): Yep, I'll take it. Creating runbook checklist and initial postmortem draft.
Jun Park (runtime): Follow-ups: 1) add a short-circuit layer in gateway to prevent cascading calls when org-lookup timeouts spike 2) add alert for control-plane queue depth 3) revert cache TTL change and add canary with synthetic load test.
Mateo Cruz (platform): Logged an infra ticket to tune HPA thresholds and check autoscaler logs.
Sam Li (oncall): Noted. Customer comms: Operations -> draft: "We experienced elevated 5xx errors due to a control-plane dependency regression affecting org-lookup and billing-config calls. We rolled back the config change and enabled fail-open caching; services are recovering. Root cause investigation in progress." Priya will update with timeline.
Priya Desai (eng-sre): I've attached preliminary timeline to incident page and flagged tenants with higher SLA. Starting outreach to top 10 customers now.
Incident Bot: :white_check_mark: Status update: mitigation steps deployed, 5xx rate now ~2.1% and falling. Monitoring for recurrences.
Sam Li (oncall): OK I'm handing off to Priya at 13:55 UTC. Leaving runbook notes in the incident page.
Priya Desai (eng-sre): Taking over. I'll coordinate the postmortem and SRE/Platform/RTE follow-ups. Will include specific remediation: revert TTL change, improve autoscaler metrics, add circuit-breaker on org-lookup.
Mateo Cruz (platform): Confirmed no further deploys to control-plane until postmortem and gating tests added.
Sam Li (oncall): Thanks all. :thumbsup:
Priya Desai (eng-sre): Updating incident status to "mitigated" on the page, will follow up with RCA and action items.
Incident Bot: Incident closed for active mitigation at 2026-03-10T13:58:40Z (ts=1781205120) - follow-ups tracked in postmortem page: https://wiki.redwood.ai/incidents/1781204321-pm"
